title: Accessibility statements now have a home on GitHub
summary:
GitHub now highlights ACCESSIBILITY.md files and helps maintainers document accessibility goals, known barriers, supported environments, contributor expectations, and reporting processes.

The post Accessibility statements now have a home on GitHub appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
llm_summary: GitHub is now giving visibility to ACCESSIBILITY.md files, letting open‑source projects publish a dedicated accessibility statement right alongside their code. The new feature guides maintainers in outlining their accessibility goals, known barriers, supported environments, contributor expectations, and how users can report issues,
